name: Arezzo
notes: Dishes and descriptions from the menu on the restaurant's own website; prices from Arezzo's own Toast ordering page (the website shows no prices). Dishes only on the Toast menu are included without descriptions; Trofie al Pesto is on the website but not on Toast, so it has no price. Soup and risotto of the day are market price. The bottle wine list is not included. Address and phone from the website.
taglineEn: Italian ristorante with house-made pasta and wood-fired pizza on the Saugatuck River
taglineEs: Restaurante italiano con pasta casera y pizza al horno de leña junto al río Saugatuck
